6.title: My name is...
6.titleCategory: D — 占位句，缺真实名字

learningObjective.text: 学会用 "My name is [name]" 介绍自己。同伴用 Hello, [name]! 回应。理解这是自我介绍，不是见面握手礼，也不是齐喊名字清单。

questionTask.learnerAction: 小朋友，课堂情境：Two children tell each other their names on a desert-oasis path.。哪一句英语表达是「My name is...」？

spokenDialogue.notes: A/B/A/B/Both aligned. Each child says own My name is once; then greet by name; play. No name-pair chant.

mustShow: Child A points to own chest while saying My name is Tom
Child B points to own chest while saying My name is Lily
Child A greets Lily by name; Child B greets Tom by name; smiles, no handshake
Uncluttered desert-oasis path; two children only in the foreground
mustNotShow: greeting wave as the main lesson
readable text, letters, labels, blackboard, teacher, flashcards, UI, titles
visualSemantics.sceneHint: Child A introduces as Tom, Child B as Lily, each with chest-point; they greet each other by name and turn to play; no handshake.

videoPromptInput.sourceSituation: Two children introduce themselves with My name is [name], greet each other by name, then go play; self-intro lesson, not a handshake meeting

learningObjective.text: 学会用 "What's your name?" 问名字，并用 My name is [name] 回答。对话要像小朋友真的在问，而不是两边各喊两遍同一句。

questionTask.learnerAction: 小朋友，课堂情境：Ask a friend for a name.。哪一句英语表达是「你叫什么名字？」？

spokenDialogue.notes: Single clear What's your name? A=Tom B=Lily consistent. No robot double question. No empty We are friends.

mustShow: Child A asks with a small open-palm gesture toward Child B
Child B points to own chest while answering My name is Lily
Child A points to own chest while saying My name is Tom
Child B greets Tom by name; both turn to play; no handshake
mustNotShow: readable text, letters, labels, blackboard, teacher, flashcards, UI, titles
visualSemantics.sceneHint: Child A asks What's your name?; Child B answers Lily; Child A says My name is Tom; Child B says Hello, Tom; they play.

videoPromptInput.sourceSituation: One child asks What's your name?, hears My name is Lily, then says My name is Tom, and is greeted Hello, Tom before they play

8.title: I'm Chen Jie
8.titleCategory: E — 绑定教材人物身份

learningObjective.text: 学会用 "I'm [name]" 介绍自己，并听懂对方用 Hello, [name]! 回应。与 L006 的 My name is 形成句型对比；不要肯定句自我重复两遍。

questionTask.learnerAction: 小朋友，课堂情境：A child states her name to a peer; the peer listens and gives a name statement back.。哪一句英语表达是「I'm Chen Jie」？

spokenDialogue.notes: A=Chen Jie B=Mike consistent with A/B/A/B/Both. I'm + name once each; greet by name; play. No Yes-I'm loop, no name-pair chant.

mustShow: Girl Child A points to own chest while saying I'm Chen Jie
Boy Child B points to own chest while saying I'm Mike
Child A greets Mike by name; Child B greets Chen Jie by name
No nametag or readable text; uncluttered desert-oasis path
mustNotShow: questioning gesture as if asking for a name
readable text, letters, labels, blackboard, teacher, flashcards, UI, titles
name-pair cheer pose with mouthed list of both names
visualSemantics.sceneHint: Girl says I'm Chen Jie, boy says I'm Mike, each with chest-point; they greet each other by name and go play.
